findings.text: **An-a-logos / supramental — Why?** gathers the differentiated whole into an act: why this response, here, to this person, now? Information, clarification, challenge, creation and silence have different purposes within an encounter. The person addressed is the actual complementary pole of this communication, whose intention and capacity to answer give the response its occasion. The QL/Epi supramental turn extends the fivefold Gebser correspondence into this whole-act return; it is not a sixth st
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Gebser himself supplied six structures including a supramental sixth.
findings.why_live_here: Five named Gebser correspondences immediately precede the QL/Epi supramental extension.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The single local attribution distinction preserves the historical fivefold and the authored sixfold together.

findings.text: These causes act together. A prompt's words are material to interpretation and already formalised intention; they are not the whole freedom from which the commission arose. An evaluator helps stabilise a candidate but does not thereby author the purpose it serves. A delegated act can therefore retain genuine judgment while remaining accountable to its commission. Where its encounter exposes a false premise, preserving the purpose can require reformulating the question rather than producing the e
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: A prompt or evaluator exhausts the originating purpose.
findings.why_live_here: The passage separates the material words, organising evaluator and purpose of one delegated act.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The difference permits correction of an instruction while preserving its commission.

findings.text: Together with L1, this pair joins production and encounter: a formed act leaves a trace; a challenge can expose its causal or evaluative conditions; a discovered relation can change the next act. A more elaborate explanation is not automatically a richer trace of actual processing. The minimum account must locate which source, model state, permission or evaluator was involved and what the return changed.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: An elaborate retrospective explanation proves which internal process occurred.
findings.why_live_here: Traces are being assigned evidential work in the Scientific sequence.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Actual conditioning must be connected to the account; eloquence cannot substitute for that connection.

findings.text: Dignāga makes a term determinate through exclusion, and the double negation carries real weight: *cow* as *not non-cow* does not collapse into plain affirmation because the two negations function differently. The excluded field remains constitutive of the determination.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: The two negations in not non-cow cancel as the same operation.
findings.why_live_here: The inherited apoha passage explicitly compares different kinds of negation.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Their different offices preserve the constitutive excluded field.

findings.text: The contrast matters technically because the bare argmax index is locally constant away from decision boundaries and discontinuous at them: it does not supply the differentiable learning signal used by ordinary gradient training through a probability loss. Learning uses differentiable fields around such choices or other training estimators and objectives. The asymmetry gives the philosophical distinction a technical object: the selected mark and the field through which selection was learned are
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: A hard argmax index supplies the useful ordinary pathwise gradient of a probability loss.
findings.why_live_here: The text compares the selected index and its surrounding differential field.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Local constancy and switching discontinuity explain why their learning offices differ.

findings.text: Apoha brings a semantic and epistemic depth the token operation does not itself supply. The point of relation is narrower and exact: determination through exclusion, with the excluded field remaining relevant to what the positive determination means. This makes provenance part of the technical problem. Retaining a token distribution is not enough where prompt, source authority, gauge, context or excluded alternatives materially shaped the selection and then disappeared from the account.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Keeping a token distribution alone preserves the full semantic and epistemic conditions of the answer.
findings.why_live_here: The preceding paragraph draws a token-operation/apoha comparison.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Prompt, source authority, gauge and context remain distinct conditioning relations.

findings.text: The [mathematics history](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/mathematics/DEVELOPMENT.md#50--evaluation-returns-to-the-practice-selecting-it) historicises this operation. Vaswani’s attention weights values through a softmax distribution; the selected PyTorch definitions distinguish that distribution from argmax’s index, including the first-maximum tie convention. Scores, weights and a selected mark retain separate jobs. Preserving the weights does not itself preserve the prompt, source autho
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Attention weights also preserve prompt and source authority.
findings.why_live_here: The paragraph compares retained weights with other conditions of selection.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The array of weights and the grounds of its use carry different information.

findings.text: J-Space returns to [Count-to-Account](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-to-account) as a proposed inspectable account of judgment formation. Source, representation, gauge and permission identify different possible causes of divergence; the record must say which changed and what followed. A narrated explanation alone cannot establish those transitions, and the subordinate research object does not exhaust Objective Internality.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: A J-Space narration establishes an executed causal transition or exhausts Objective Internality.
findings.why_live_here: A proposed model of judgment formation is being assigned explanatory work.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The proposal needs an actual transition and remains a selected representation within the means.

findings.text: A judgment position returns to [Topos — situated return](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#topos-situated-return) with its source-field, gauge and inherited conditions. Two outputs occupying comparable coordinates can have different histories or permissions. The proposed J-Space record must retain those differences before a passage between positions counts as an accountable comparison; naming a space does not establish the research architecture’s operation.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Comparable coordinates imply equivalent history and permission.
findings.why_live_here: The specific example concerns two outputs at comparable locations.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The accountable comparison must preserve the distinct source and permission relations.

findings.text: The double-net distinction gives the technical image its full charge. A contextual field remains Indra-like when its grounds, relations, and returns remain constitutive and answerable across the field. It becomes Hephaestian when an owner, protocol, or audience occupies the hidden zero, turning participants into exposed and ranked terms inside a web they cannot contest or return through.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: An enclosure is answerable merely because it exposes and ranks its participants.
findings.why_live_here: The inherited double-net comparison contrasts reciprocal relation with protected control.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The capacity to contest the governing relation distinguishes their operations.

findings.text: Two determinations from the myth complete the claim. The displaced trust is also displaced labour: annotators, raters, evaluator models, and reference policies are themselves held "to stand by… on call for a further ordering" (*QCT*, p. 17) — human relation kept as standing-reserve inside the optimisation loop, present in every score and named in none. And the Homeric scene supplies the exact shape of the observability limit. The net detects (Helios's σκοπιή), captures (δεσμοὶ τεχνήεντες), prove
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Detection, capture, proof and pricing already release the bound parties or settle liability.
findings.why_live_here: The complete inherited net sequence places surety after those operations.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The pledge has a distinct institutional office. The source-specific scene/quotes are retained at their inherited standing, not freshly collated here.

findings.text: [the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-account-answerability) figures a criterion protected by controlling the available answer: election publicity can supply Six's public response before he has assented, then count participation as endorsement of an office he cannot govern. The return asks whether adverse encounter can revise the evaluator's terms, rather than merely change a score within them.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Participation in an administered election grants authority to change its terms.
findings.why_live_here: The Prisoner example describes Six receiving a public role while its terms remain protected.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The distinction identifies whether return changes the evaluator or only a score within it.

findings.text: [Renewed entrustment](../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) brings the preference movement back to the bearer of an undertaking: prior reliance and renewed entrustment cannot be settled by transparency alone. A disclosed preference still has consequences for someone whose authority to answer must survive the evaluation. The technical account therefore returns to that commission instead of making its confidence score the measure of trust.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Observability or a confidence score alone establishes renewed entrustment.
findings.why_live_here: The passage moves from inspected comparison to the person bearing reliance.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: An undertaking and its consequences retain a bearer who can answer.

findings.text: The disputed preference returns to [Apportionment / Economy whole — Measure is an apportioned criterion](../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#measure-is-an-apportioned-criterion) through the conditions of the comparison. A disputed preference can require revision of the criterion or the office selecting it. A new score under an unchanged criterion does not discharge that return.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: A changed score fulfils a challenge to the criterion producing scores.
findings.why_live_here: The objection is explicitly directed at the criterion or selecting office.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Returned difference must reach that office, not merely another selected result.

findings.text: A source's claim, a person's report, a retrieved passage, a model's inference and the world they concern can all enter one active context. They enter through different relations. The words “the experiment succeeded” might quote a report, express the user's belief, state an observed result or repeat an inference from incomplete evidence. A fitting answer keeps track of which act those words perform here. Their presence in the context does not make the relations interchangeable.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Identical words in context have identical evidential offices.
findings.why_live_here: The example is the same sentence as quotation, belief, observation or inference.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Keeping these relations distinct is the positive relational-Logos operation.

findings.text: **Dia-logos / mythical — How?** lets the distinguished terms move in relation. A claim may depend on a source, a reply may answer a prior concern, and an image may figure a relation that a formula states differently. Dependence, sequence, causation, polarity and analogy each have their own consequences. Recognising which relation is active makes the passage from one term to the next intelligible; a shared word alone does not supply that passage.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Shared vocabulary by itself establishes dependence, causation or analogy.
findings.why_live_here: Several different term-to-term relations are named in the same dimension.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Their operations and consequences must be distinguished for an inference to follow.

findings.text: A comparison can hold task, available sources and relevant runtime conditions constant while varying a declared lens or disclosure. It then asks whether a challenge changed the answer, task, model, gauge or commission, and which later act inherited the change. A null result can expose an ineffective implementation, a mistaken mapping or an inadequate discriminator; these different findings require different repairs. A stored account of a proposed change is not evidence that the changed condition
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Recording a proposed revision establishes that a later act inherited it.
findings.why_live_here: The paragraph specifies an experimental comparison of changed conditions.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The actual later consequence is the discriminator; a proposal record is a different event.

findings.text: A source's statement, a report of that statement, an observation and an inference from it have different offices. So do the person claiming something, the person receiving it and the current act of interpretation. The same words can be present in each relation. Their presence alone cannot establish which relation produced the present claim. The [relational Logos of Actuation](../products/S1-Actuation.md#4--relational-logos-this-act-addresses-someone) makes these positions explicit so a response
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: The presence of a sentence establishes whether it is observation, report or inference.
findings.why_live_here: The passage explicitly uses the same words in different source relations.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The actual producing relation must remain identified.

findings.text: What belongs to the field is established through actual conditioning. A named source that was never consulted and a rule that did not govern selection cannot explain this judgment merely because a later narration mentions them. The inquiry must connect the represented condition to the act it is supposed to explain.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: A source named only after a judgment is evidence that it caused the judgment.
findings.why_live_here: The passage concerns explaining the formation of this judgment.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The connection between condition and act must be established, not retrofitted by narration.

findings.text: A model can then model its own judgment field, and another can inspect that model. Each return discloses another determinate relation within the means. The gain lies in what becomes available to correction. [MEF](C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) keeps the lens and warrant of each reading distinct, so apparent agreement between maps does not conceal different sources or criteria.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: Agreement between maps implies identical sources and criteria.
findings.why_live_here: MEF is being used to compare separate readings.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The warrants remain distinct despite agreement in results.

findings.text: An address can challenge the representation, its parameters, the evaluation or the purpose governing the search. This inscription specifies a proposed scope of revision; it is not an executed learning rule. Its test must name which component changed, how the change was made and what later judgment depended on it. A better answer under a fixed measure and an encounter that revises the measure are different results.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: The tuple transition is an executed or sufficiently specified learning algorithm.
findings.why_live_here: A mathematical arrow has just represented a proposed wider scope of revision.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: Its components, mechanism and later effects still need actual operational demonstration.

findings.text: The six products give changed conditions different places to enter. [Actuation](../products/S1-Actuation.md) carries the judgment as an event; [Central](../products/S0-Central.md) can receive a revised source or commission; [AIKit](../products/S2-AIKit.md), altered means or permissions; [Factory](../products/S3-Software-Factory.md), a transformation to integrate; [Workcell](../products/S4-Workcell.md), changed material conditions; and [Quaternal Logic](../products/S5-Quaternal-Logic.md), a chang
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: The judgment-field representation contains the entire six-product Life/World relation.
findings.why_live_here: Six distinct offices receive different kinds of returned change.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: The bounded map is one articulation within that larger means and needs routes to the other offices.

findings.text: Functional articulation becomes philosophically consequential when its return reaches the conditions that generated the act. A model can retain alternatives, revisit sources, revise an evaluator or initiate a different action; a fluent explanation of change is not enough unless the relevant source, permission, gauge or commission actually changes. [Operational Parity](../../../symbolon/episteme/concepts/C45-Operational-Parity.md) therefore asks for the later act that inherited the difference.
findings.mistaken_stronger_proposition: An explanation of change establishes an effective return.
findings.why_live_here: The movement assigns philosophical consequence to source/evaluator/permission revision.
findings.information_lost_without_distinction: A later act must inherit a changed condition; the explanation alone leaves that question unresolved.
